Yes, **Patterson Companies** is a major value-added specialty distributor. They supply and distribute products, equipment, and technology to the dental and animal health markets (including veterinary and pet care) across North America and the United Kingdom. [](https://www.pattersoncompanies.com/what-we-do/)

- **Dental Products:** Restorative materials, infection control items, hand instruments, and sterilization equipment through Patterson Dental. [](https://publiccompany.distributionstrategy.com/company/detail/35)

- **Animal Health Products:** Veterinary supplies, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, and equipment for clinics and producers through [Patterson Veterinary](https://www.pattersonvet.com/) and Animal Health International. [](https://www.pattersoncompanies.com/what-we-do/)

- **Technology & Services:** Practice management software, digital X-ray systems, equipment repair, and office design services
